summary.text: Lydia Xinzhen Brown is a Democratic candidate for the Maryland House of Delegates, District 7A, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She was also the Democratic nominee for the same district in 2022.

paragraphs.text: Lydia Xinzhen Brown, who is also known as Ly Xīnzhèn, advanced from the July 19, 2022 Democratic primary for Maryland House of Delegates District 7A.
In the November 8, 2022 general election, she received 25.5 percent of the vote, and Republicans Kathy Szeliga and Ryan Nawrocki won the district's two seats.
Brown advanced from the June 23, 2026 Democratic primary and is on the November 2026 ballot for District 7A.
